parsed.post: Discarding the last run (1.002096). It appears the jump to MATRIX_LR=0.05 caused a regression from my best (0.999450). I'm reverting to the successful DEPTH=6, ASPECT_RATIO=64, MATRIX_LR=0.04, WEIGHT_DECAY=0.01 configuration. Next, I'll experiment with increasing WEIGHT_DECAY slightly to see if better regularization can push the BPB even lower.
parsed.description: Increasing WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.01 to 0.05 on the best configuration (D6, AR64, LR0.04, WD0.01) to test if stronger regularization improves generalization.
